title: 5 choices for the base build (S1) before code starts
detail: The base builder copies the product shell from the reference repo. These five points differ from it or have no clear answer there. Accept the recommended answer or change it.

items.q: Error replies: the API standard wants plain problem details with no wrapper, the shell keeps its ApiResponse wrapper. Keep the split (wrapper for shell pages, problem details for /api/v1)?
items.rec: Keep the split: shell endpoints keep the wrapper, every DeskBook /api/v1 endpoint uses problem details.

items.q: Database changes: the source runs SQL scripts by hand. Use Flyway (a new dependency) instead?
items.rec: Use Flyway: numbered scripts run on start, same on every system.

items.q: Can any TTCommon jar (Jam, SFTP, Sharepoint, LMS) be dropped?
items.rec: Keep all of them until the base is built and tested, then drop the unused ones in one pass.

items.q: Sign-in roles: xs-security.json has no role templates today. Add them?
items.rec: Add two role templates, USER and ADMIN, so the BTP admin can assign DeskBook roles (ADR-7, Q69).

items.q: Labels from the database: disableLoadMessages=true was set in an older commit and removed on dev. Which one?
items.rec: Follow dev: remove it, so custom labels load from the database.
